project.name: Balcurvie
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 12 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. The single farm attraction is separately scored and does not make the hamlet a 60+ town. Leven and Windygates cafés and public facilities are outside the boundary.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Balcurvie has one genuine bookable attraction—Claireville Alpacas—but the hamlet otherwise lacks a café, maintained place trail and public facilities. The attraction appears in See while Balcurvie itself stays below 60.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Outdoor access can work for responsible dog visits; venue-specific policies are recorded individually.

visitorHighlights.name: Claireville Alpaca Farm
visitorHighlights.reason: A working-farm experience offering pre-booked alpaca walks, meet-and-greets and encounters with other farm animals.
visitorHighlights.tagline: Bookable alpaca walks in the countryside
visitorHighlights.openingTimes: Book in advance; current sessions and availability vary.
visitorHighlights.admission: About £15 for the advertised 45-minute alpaca walk; confirm when booking

editorialReview.scoreRationale: Claireville Alpaca Farm is separately assessed for visit depth, distinctiveness, presentation, journey worth, access reliability and evidence quality.

sources.name: Historic Environment Scotland NRHE / trove.scot Points GIS
sources.coverage: NRHE records whose representative points lie within the authoritative Balcurvie parish extent
sources.accessMethod: Developer-supplied local HES Shapefile; exact parish containment
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; retain Historic Environment Scotland attribution.
sources.limitations: The spatial index provides a representative site point, names and classifications. It does not establish construction dates; detailed source records require individual review.

sources.name: Historic Environment Scotland Scheduled Monuments spatial data
sources.coverage: Scheduled monuments intersecting the strict editorial boundary
sources.accessMethod: Developer-supplied local HES Shapefile; exact boundary intersection
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; retain Historic Environment Scotland attribution.
sources.limitations: The spatial layer supplies designation and location, not a historic construction period. Undated records remain in the catalogue but are hidden from the heat map.

sources.name: Historic Environment Scotland Listed Buildings spatial data
sources.coverage: Balcurvie editorial district plus 500m heritage buffer; buffer records are retained as related context
sources.accessMethod: Developer-supplied local HES Shapefile; exact polygon selection
sources.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; retain Historic Environment Scotland attribution.
sources.limitations: Balcurvie has no separate NRS locality boundary. The transparent visitor-guide editorial boundary is used and buffer records remain context only. The source supplies statutory designation and location metadata, not construction dates.
